id: python-flask-pyload-plugin-config-write-missing-admin-check
title: Config setter writes plugin options without an ADMIN role check
summary: 'The API config setter writes plugin options with `config.set_plugin(...)` and no ADMIN role
  check. A user with only the SETTINGS permission could change security-critical plugin options such as
  AntiVirus `avfile` and `avargs`, which leads to command execution. The core-option check was also incomplete:
  it failed open on RuntimeError and left out `storage_folder`.

  '
cwe:
- CWE-269
- CWE-78
severity: high
confidence: medium
languages:
- python
source:
  kind: fix-commit
  ref: c4cf995a2803bdbe388addfc2b0f323277efc0e1
  vulnerable_ref: c4cf995a2803bdbe388addfc2b0f323277efc0e1^
  patched_ref: c4cf995a2803bdbe388addfc2b0f323277efc0e1
  repository: https://github.com/pyload/pyload
rule:
  message: 'Plugin config value is written via set_plugin() in a config setter that never computes or
    checks an ADMIN role. Non-admin users with the SETTINGS permission can modify security-critical plugin
    options (e.g. executable paths and arguments).

    '
  patterns:
  - pattern: self.pyload.config.set_plugin($C, $O, $V)
  - pattern-inside: "def $F(self, ..., section: str = ..., ...):\n    ...\n"
  - pattern-not-inside: "def $F(self, ..., section: str = ..., ...):\n    ...\n    $A = $B.get(\"role\"\
      ) == Role.ADMIN\n    ...\n"
fix:
  guidance: 'Determine the caller''s role once at the start of the setter (from flask.g.user_info or the
    session; treat calls outside a Flask request as internal/admin). Keep separate deny-lists of admin-only
    core options and admin-only plugin options (including storage_folder, proxy credentials, and AntiVirus
    avfile/avargs). Log an error and return before writing when the option is on the relevant list and
    the caller is not an admin. Do not swallow RuntimeError in a way that skips the check.

    '
  example: "try:\n    try:\n        user_info = flask.g.user_info\n    except AttributeError:\n      \
    \  user_info = flask.session\nexcept RuntimeError:\n    user_info = {\"role\": Role.ADMIN}\nis_admin\
    \ = user_info.get(\"role\") == Role.ADMIN\n\nADMIN_ONLY_PLUGIN_OPTIONS = {(\"AntiVirus\", \"avfile\"\
    ), (\"AntiVirus\", \"avargs\")}\n\nif section == \"plugin\":\n    if (category, option) in ADMIN_ONLY_PLUGIN_OPTIONS\
    \ and not is_admin:\n        self.pyload.log.error(\"Writing config value requires Admin role\")\n\
    \        return\n    self.pyload.config.set_plugin(category, option, value)\n"
